sentences.text: This miscellaneous appeal by appellants/claimants under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act.

1988 is arising out of the Award dated 09-01-2024 passed by Second Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Rajgarh (hereinafter it would be referred to as "the Claims Tribunal") in MACCNo.
335 of 2021 seeking enhancement of compensation amount.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. The date of accident, negligence and issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.
3.

As per the findings of the Claims Tribunal, for the death of Amar Singh Jatav (husband of appellant No.1- herein), the Claims Tribunal after assessing the income of deceased at Rs.6250/- per month, applying 25% towards future prospects and applying multiplier of 13 including filial consortium, funeral and loss of estate, has awarded a total compensation of Rs. 8,89,500/-
along-with interest in favour of Claimants from the date of filing of claim petition till its NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35242 2 MA-2672-2024 realization.
4.

Learned counsel for the appellants contends that Claims Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is on the lower side.
The Claims Tribunal has committed an error in assessing the income of the deceased as Rs.6250/- per month.
As per the evidence came on record, he was labourer by Mohanbai vs Shahban Ali on 11 December, 2024

1 profession.

However, accepting earning of deceased as Rs.8,700/- per month in view of the Workman Compensations Act and adding future prospects, applying adequate multiplier, the reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for Insurance Company has argued in support of the impugned Award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case, which does not call for any interference by this Court.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellants.

So far as income of the deceased is concerned, as per the evidence that came on record, he was an unskilled labourer, therefore, in view of Workman Compensation Act his income should be assessed as Rs.8700/- per month.

Therefore,
his income is fixed as Rs.8700/-/- per month instead of Rs.6250/- per month as assessed by the Claims Tribunal.

8. It is needless to mention here that appellant No.1 is the wife, Appellant Nos. 2 to 4 are sons and Appellant No.5 is father of deceased,therefore, all of them are entitled to get towards the loss of consortium @ Rs.44,400/- each.

9. In view of above, the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal is modified as under:
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35242 3 MA-2672-2024 HEAD AMOUNT Total Income (Rs.8700/-pm Future prospects 25% Dependency 1/3rd Multiplier 13 Loss of income: (Rs.8700+25% FP-1/3rd x 12x13) =Rs. 11,31,000 /-
Other Heads:-
Loss of filial Consortium-(Rs.44,000X 5) =Rs. 2,20,000/-
 Funeral expenses = Rs.16,5  Loss of Estate = Rs. 16,5 ----------------------------------------------------------------------
TOTAL =Rs.13,84,000/-
10.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.13,84,000/- as against the Award of the Claims Tribunal of Rs.8,89,500/-.
Accordingly, the appellants/claimants are entitled to an additional sum of Rs.4,94,500/- over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.

sentences.text: In the result, this miscellaneous appeal is partly allowed, by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.4,94,500/-.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as fixed by the learned Claims Tribunal from the date of filing of claim petition till its realization.
The said amount be paid within a period of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Rest of conditions as imposed by learned Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.

12. If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellants- claimants within a period of one month and proof thereof, shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, the Registry shall issue the certified NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35242 4 MA-2672-2024 copy of the order passed today.
13. In view of above, miscellaneous appeal filed by the appellants- claimants stands disposed of.
